name: cache-wrap-missing-single-flight
title: read-through cache helper without single-flight (stampede risk)
detail: A file defines/calls a read-through cache wrapper (getCached/cacheService.wrap/cache.wrap) but has no in-flight promise guard. Concurrent misses on the same key each rebuild independently — a cache-stampede: N callers, N rebuilds, N DB hits. Approximation note: file-present-absent scope is per-file, so a guard defined in a sibling module (not re-exported or re-implemented in the flagged file) won't be detected as covering it — verify manually before treating a finding as confirmed.
fix: wrap the miss path in an in-flight promise map (Map<key, Promise>) so concurrent callers for the same key share one fetch: check inFlight.get(key) before calling the fetcher, inFlight.set(key, promise) before awaiting, inFlight.delete(key) in a finally.
source_lesson: cache-stampede reel audit 2026-07-13 (store/whatsapp): stampede = concurrent misses -> N rebuilds; single-flight promise map is the standard fix
